function.name: n44-notifications
function.authorization: private signed ingress + official AuthClient verified claims/fresh user + original current-session DB lock; no unaudited parser

scheduler.name: n44-notifications-scheduler
scheduler.proposedCadence: once per minute only after explicit activation
scheduler.bounds: at most 4 pages x 25 due rows then 25-row cleanup per invocation

roles.n44_backend: NOLOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS; private DML only, no Auth/canonical reads
roles.n44_guard: NOLOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS; private read_source owner, column-limited canonical locks under owner RLS
roles.postgres: existing management role only; lock_current_session owner, no managed Auth ownership/RLS/policy change, no new BYPASSRLS

unprovenExistingCapability: postgres REFERENCES(auth.users.id) must be read back before apply; synthetic conditional capability only. Never grant automatically.

edge: N44_AUTH_API_KEY (publishable/anon key only; reject service_role by custody)
serverCustody.databaseCredential: later separately approved LOGIN for n44_backend only, TLS verified; no URL in CLI/history/artifacts; no password provided
serverCustody.keySeparation: all 32-byte ingress/scheduler/rate/sealing/endpoint-HMAC/binding-HMAC keys distinct, server only; P256 VAPID private key server only

postapply: fresh Auth policy readback and original session semantics
provider function/route/config source hashes, disabled flags, NO active cron
separately approved hosted fixture/device proof before explicit enable
killSwitch: disable ingress, scheduler and N44_DELIVERY_ENABLED then N44_ENABLED; drain exact old runtime before retiring approval/bindings. Preserve durable receipts; do not drop tables/replay uncertain sends.
